nodes.description: Ownable.owner address; initialized from msg.sender and written by setOwner, used by the onlyOwner guard.
TournamentPass.balances mapping of token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, mint and purchase.
TournamentPass.supply total minted passes, updated through SafeMath in mint and purchase.
TournamentPass.mintLimit hard cap (20000) on total supply checked in mint.
TournamentPass.minters array of addresses authorized to mint, consulted by isMinter.
TournamentPass.price (250 finney) required payment per pass in purchase.
PresalePackFour.purchases array of Purchase structs storing user, count, commit block, randomness and current claim index.
PresalePackFour.canClaim boolean gate checked at the start of claim.
PresalePackFour.perClaim (default 15) bounding how many packs a single claim call processes.
PresalePackFour.vault CappedVault instance that receives purchase payments.
PackFourMultiplier.packs whitelist of prior pack contracts accepted by isPriorPack.
PackFourMultiplier.multiplier (default 3) scaling extra packs granted to the last card owner.
PackFourMultiplier.packLimit (default 5) gating the migration loop in claimMultiple.
Pausable.paused flag toggled by pause/unpause and checked by whenNotPaused and claimPheonix.
Governable.governor privileged address set at construction and via setGovernor.
CappedVault.withdrawn running total incremented after each owner withdrawal.
ShinyLegendaryPackFour.tournament TournamentPass contract minted after purchases and claimMultiple.
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; used by setOwner, Vault.withdraw, withdrawAll, CappedVault.withdraw, withdraw functions and token admin entry points.
Ownable.setOwner writes the owner state variable, guarded by onlyOwner.
Vault.withdraw(uint amount) checks the balance then sends funds to owner with owner.transfer.
Vault.withdrawAll forwards the entire contract balance to withdraw().
TournamentPass.mint(address to, uint amount) restricted to registered minters via isMinter(msg.sender).
TournamentPass.purchase(uint amount) payable; checks price*mount, mints passes and forwards msg.value to the vault.
TournamentPass.transfer(address to, uint value) moves balances using SafeMath sub/add.
TournamentPass.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value) spends allowance of msg.sender.
CappedVault.withdraw(uint amount) transfers to owner and then increments withdrawn.
PresalePackFour._purchase(address user, uint16 packCount, address referrer) records a Purchase and forwards funds to referrer and vault.
PresalePackFour.purchase(uint16 packCount, address referrer) payable entry point delegating to _purchase.
PresalePackFour.callback(uint id) derives randomness from blockhash of the commit block and stores it in the Purchase.
PresalePackFour.claim(uint id) loops over card slots calling the external migration.createCard and advances p.current afterwards.
PresalePackFour.recommit(uint id) allows re-committing a purchase after 256 blocks.
PresalePackFour.calculatePrice(uint base, uint16 packCount) computes a time-based discount from block.number.
PresalePackFour.withdraw() owner-only transfer of the whole balance.
PackFourMultiplier.claimMultiple(address pack, uint purchaseID) calls an external pack contract, mints extra purchases, claims a pheonix and migrates cards.
ShinyLegendaryPackFour.purchase(uint16 packCount, address referrer) calls super.purchase then mints tournament passes to msg.sender.
ShinyLegendaryPackFour.claimMultiple forwards to super.claimMultiple and mints the extra tournament passes.
FirstPheonix.claimPheonix(address user) restricted to approved callers, calls core.createCard externally.
CardProto.getRandomCard(Rarity, uint16 random) selects a proto id by modulo indexing into rarity arrays.
CardProto._addProto internal writes a ProtoCard, increments protoCount and pushes the id into rarity arrays.
Governable.setGovernor(address _gov) writes the governor state variable, guarded by onlyGovernor.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, mint authorization, balance debits and purchase attribution.
External call owner.transfer(amount) / owner.transfer(address(this).balance) sending Ether to the owner address.
External call address(vault).transfer(msg.value) in TournamentPass.purchase.
External call migration.createCard(user, proto, purity) executed inside the claim loop before p.current is updated.
External call referrer.transfer(commission) to a caller-supplied address in _purchase.
External call address(vault).transfer(price) forwarding the remaining purchase price.
External call PresalePackFour(pack).claim(purchaseID) on a caller-supplied pack contract in claimMultiple.
Weight randomness: uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(p.commit), p.user, address(this), p.count))) is miner-influenceable.
Arithmetic (base - (((20 - numDays) * base) / 100)) * packCount discount computation in calculatePrice.
Unchecked arithmetic withdrawn += amount executed after an external transfer in CappedVault.withdraw.
SafeMath add/sub arithmetic used for supply and balance updates in mint, purchase and transfer paths.
External call pheonix.claimPheonix(lastCardOwner) from claimMultiple.
External call migration.migrate(...) repeated in a loop inside claimMultiple.
External call core.createCard(user, PHEONIX_PROTO, 0) inside claimPheonix.
External call owner.transfer(amount) inside CappedVault.withdraw before withdrawn is updated.
uint amount parameter of Vault.withdraw / CappedVault.withdraw bounding the transferred value.
uint16 packCount parameter of purchase/_purchase determining the number of packs bought.
address referrer parameter, caller-supplied recipient of the commission transfer.
address user parameter, the account credited with purchased packs.
uint purchaseID parameter selecting the Purchase entry to be claimed.
address pack parameter naming the external PresalePackFour contract called by claimMultiple.
uint id parameter indexing the purchases array in callback, claim and recommit.
Local uint price computed from basePrice and packCount in _purchase.
Local uint commission = price / 10 sent to the referrer.
Local uint random derived from blockhash in callback and persisted as p.randomness.
Local uint numDays = (block.number - creationBlock) / 6000 used in the discount formula.
Local uint16 cardDifference = lengthAfter - length measured around the external claim call.
Local uint16 extra = packCount * multiplier granting extra purchases to the last card owner.

edges.reason: owner is initialized from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor, so the privilege root is caller-controlled.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to authorize privileged calls.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable when validating msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates setOwner.
setOwner writes the owner state variable, transferring full contract control.
onlyOwner gates Vault.withdraw.
Vault.withdraw performs an external Ether transfer to owner inside the guarded function.
The amount parameter bounds the balance check and the transferred value in withdraw.
withdrawAll forwards the whole balance to withdraw().
onlyOwner gates withdrawAll.
mint authorizes msg.sender through isMinter before crediting balances.
The minters array is read to decide whether the caller may mint.
mintLimit bounds amount.add(supply) before supply is increased.
mint increases the supply state variable using SafeMath add.
mint relies on SafeMath add/sub routing for supply and balance arithmetic.
mint credits balances[to] using SafeMath add.
The price state variable is read to require msg.value >= price.mul(amount).
purchase forwards msg.value to the vault with an external call after minting.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] based on the caller identity.
transfer updates the balances mapping with SafeMath sub and add.
transferFrom spends the allowance granted to msg.sender.
transferFrom moves value between balances entries using SafeMath.
onlyOwner gates CappedVault.withdraw.
CappedVault.withdraw sends Ether to owner before updating withdrawn.
withdrawn is incremented after the external transfer inside withdraw.
The withdrawn += amount statement is the unchecked arithmetic sink of withdraw.
The public purchase entry point delegates all logic to _purchase.
ShinyLegendaryPackFour.purchase calls super.purchase, propagating the payment and vault transfer.
purchase mints tournament passes to msg.sender after the payment flow.
The vault state variable is the destination of the price transfer in _purchase.
_purchase appends a new Purchase struct to the purchases array.
_purchase transfers the referral commission externally before completing payment routing.
_purchase transfers the remaining price to the vault with an external call.
The caller-supplied referrer address is the recipient of the commission transfer.
packCount feeds the local price computation.
The computed local price is the value forwarded to the vault.
The computed commission is transferred to the referrer.
callback builds randomness from the commit block hash, a miner-influenceable value.
The keccak256 hash result is assigned to the local random variable.
The derived randomness is persisted into the Purchase struct.
The id parameter indexes the purchases array in callback, claim and recommit.
recommit rewrites the commit block of the referenced Purchase.
claim performs external migration.createCard calls inside its card loop.
The external createCard call can re-enter claim before p.current is advanced.
p.current is updated only after the loop of external calls, leaving state inconsistent during callbacks.
canClaim gates whether the claim loop may execute.
perClaim limits the number of pack slots processed in a single claim call.
purchaseID selects the Purchase storage entry being claimed.
calculatePrice executes the discount arithmetic expression.
The numDays local derived from block.number drives the discount arithmetic.
claimMultiple calls an external PresalePackFour contract supplied by the caller.
The pack parameter is the target address of the external claim call.
The external claim call re-enters the target pack contract's claim function, enabling cross-contract reentrancy.
claimMultiple triggers an external call into the pheonix contract.
claimMultiple runs a loop of external migration.migrate calls.
The packs whitelist is consulted by isPriorPack to validate the external call target.
The multiplier state variable scales the extra packs computed in claimMultiple.
packLimit gates whether the migration loop runs in claimMultiple.
cardDifference is divided by packSize and multiplied by the multiplier to produce extra.
The extra local is used as the purchased pack count in the new Purchase entry.
claimPheonix calls the external core.createCard after marking the user as claimed.
claimPheonix validates msg.sender against the approved pack list.
The paused flag disables claimPheonix once cards become tradable.
ShinyLegendaryPackFour.claimMultiple forwards to the multiplier implementation.
After claiming, the derived extra passes are minted through TournamentPass.mint.
The tournament contract is the mint target invoked after the external claim flow.
setGovernor writes the governor state variable that anchors governance privileges.
onlyGovernor compares msg.sender against governor before allowing setGovernor.
onlyOwner gates PresalePackFour.withdraw.
PresalePackFour.withdraw transfers the whole balance to owner with an external call.
Pack card prototypes are resolved through getRandomCard during the claim flow.
Governor-only entry points add prototypes through _addProto.
The user parameter becomes the credited owner of the newly pushed Purchase.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to bound and forward the withdrawal in Vault.withdraw, so it merges into that function node.
packCount is consumed entirely by _purchase to size the Purchase record and price computation.
The referrer parameter is the recipient of the commission transfer external call.
The user parameter is written into the Purchase struct created by _purchase.
purchaseID only selects the Purchase storage slot processed by claim.
The pack parameter is the target address of the external claim call in claimMultiple.
The id parameter only indexes the purchases array dereferenced in callback.
The local price value flows directly into the vault transfer external call.
The local commission value flows directly into the referrer transfer external call.
The local random value is exactly the weak-randomness result produced by the blockhash hashing operation.
The numDays local is an isolated intermediate of the discount arithmetic in calculatePrice.
cardDifference is an intermediate measurement used only for the extra-pack computation in claimMultiple.
The extra local is an intermediate value converted into the pack count of the new Purchase in claimMultiple.
